The '''Jedi chapter house''' was the center of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] activity on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]] long before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] began.

==History==
Long before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] established a [[Jedi chapter house/Legends|chapter house]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]]. The chapter house was the site of the [[Great Seal/Legends|Great Seal]], the artifact which separated the surface world and the [[Aleen Underworld|Underworld]]; historians debated which preceded the other.<ref name="NoP" /> Used by the [[Exploration Corps/Legends|Exploration Corps]], the site employed local building techniques and favored a balance of above and below ground construction.<ref name="CRB" />For unknown reasons, the Order abandoned Aleen and their chapter house, allowing it to fall into disrepair and eventually collapse.<ref name="NoP" />

During the Clone Wars, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] established an excavation site at the ruins of the chapter house where Republic researchers attempted to understand the [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] plaguing the world. When the Republic conducted a [[Mission to Aleen/Legends|mission]] to give relief support and to assist the natives, [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] were led to the site by Aleena guides and they both accidentally fell into the hole. After coming out from a [[Water/Legends|water]] spout, R2-D2 closed the seal, restoring the balance on Aleen.<ref name="MM" />

When the Jedi Order was exterminated at the end of the war, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] searched out old academies and temples of the Jedi and destroyed them. Despite being in severe disuse, the Empire used orbital bombardment to level the remaining structures that still stood at the chapter house site. The Aleena rebuilt the sections of the temple surrounding the Great Seal, where they worshiped [[Orphne]], the protector of the [[Arbozoic tree/Legends|arbozoic trees]].<ref name="CRB" />
